title: Breadcrumb Trail
content: Create breadcrumb navigation component. Structure: list of links showing path hierarchy. Separator: chevron, slash, or arrow between items. Current page: last item not linked, styled differently. Home: optional home icon as first item. Truncation: collapse middle items with "..." for long paths. Responsive: hide middle items on mobile, show first and last. Accessibility: nav with aria-label="Breadcrumb", aria-current on current. Schema markup: BreadcrumbList structured data. Styling: text-sm text-gray-600, hover styles on links. Icons: optional icons per item. Dropdown: collapsed items show in dropdown.

variants.simple: Build breadcrumb navigation showing page hierarchy.
variants.detailed: Create breadcrumb navigation component. Structure: list of links showing path hierarchy. Separator: chevron, slash, or arrow between items. Current page: last item not linked, styled differently. Home: optional home icon as first item. Truncation: collapse middle items with "..." for long paths. Responsive: hide middle items on mobile, show first and last. Accessibility: nav with aria-label="Breadcrumb", aria-current on current. Schema markup: BreadcrumbList structured data. Styling: text-sm text-gray-600, hover styles on links. Icons: optional icons per item. Dropdown: collapsed items show in dropdown.
variants.advanced: Create comprehensive breadcrumb navigation component. Structure: nav element with aria-label="Breadcrumb", ordered list (ol) of items, each item a link except last. Separator: ChevronRight or "/" between items, aria-hidden on separator, consistent sizing (h-4 w-4 text-gray-400). Current page: last item as span (not link), aria-current="page", different styling (text-gray-900 font-medium vs text-gray-500). Home item: optional Home icon as first item, can be icon-only with aria-label="Home" or text. Truncation for long paths: if >4-5 items, show first 1-2, ellipsis dropdown, last 2 items. Ellipsis dropdown: button with "..." expands to show hidden items. Responsive: on mobile, show only home icon + current page, or just current with back arrow. Item styling: text-sm, links: text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700, current: text-gray-900. With icons: optional icon per item (Folder, File, Settings), sized h-4 w-4 mr-1. Schema markup: add structured data script with BreadcrumbList, itemListElement array with position, name, item (URL). Click navigation: clicking link navigates, current page not clickable. Back button variant: on mobile, single back button with parent page name. Styling: contained in card/bar, or minimal inline. Generation: can be auto-generated from route path or manually specified. Accessibility testing: verify screen reader announces "Breadcrumb navigation", each link, and current page.
